message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Genre | Notes |
|-------|----------------|-------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | Fantasy | First book in the Harry Potter series; introduces Hogwarts and the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Fantasy | Second book; explores the mystery of the Chamber and the basilisk. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Fantasy | Third book; introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Fantasy | Fourth book; features the Triwizard Tournament. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Fantasy | Fifth book; focuses on Dumbledore’s Army and the rise of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Fantasy | Sixth book; delves into Voldemort’s backstory and Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Fantasy | Final book; concludes the epic saga. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Contemporary Fiction | Rowling’s first adult novel; a dark drama set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Crime/Mystery | First book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Crime/Mystery | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Crime/Mystery | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Crime/Mystery | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | Children’s Fantasy | A fairy‑tale adventure set in a fictional kingdom. |

These titles span Rowling’s most famous works, from the beloved Harry Potter series to her adult novels and the crime‑fiction series written under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith.
